observed_facts: Order #W5490111 was paid with a credit card (credit_card_3124723).
The policy states that the refund must either go to the original payment method or an existing gift card.
The agent called return_delivered_order_items using paypal_9497703 as the payment method, which caused a tool error.
inference: The agent violated policy by attempting to issue a refund to a PayPal account when the original payment was made via credit card and PayPal is not a gift card.
This invalid tool call directly caused the failure of the return request and led to the user refusing the correction and requesting a human transfer.
needs_verification: Whether the policy allows overriding the refund payment method if requested by the user.
parsed.summary: The agent made an invalid tool call by attempting to refund a credit card order to a PayPal account, violating the return refund policy.
